text:
Sam H: quick heads-up — my PRs are blocked by a cross-repo ordering issue. SDK PR #412 updates the auth header shape; console PR #998 needs the new client, and helm chart pr redwood/helm#77 needs a values tweak. If we merge in the wrong order we break staging. Can we agree on sequence?
Maria G: @Sam H can you paste the minimal diff for the auth shape? i can do a quick review for the SDK side today. :eyes:
Sam H: sure — snippet below (from sdk auth client):
```js
// changed header key
const headers = {
  'x-rw-auth': token, // old was 'x-auth'
};
```
Sam H: SDK #412 ready for review, integration tests pass locally. blocking: console needs bumped SDK version and helm values need to point to the new client image tag.
Ken L: runtime/helm change is minor — we need the client image tag in helm values and a configmap key rename. I can prepare helm#77 with the values change but prefer helm merge after console so no rollback surprises.
Tara P: for staging schedule: we have a merge window today at 1700 PST. if we want canary, do SDK -> console -> helm -> runtime. SDK first so console build picks it up.
Maria G: i can approve SDK #412 by 1600 if tests look good. please push a small changelog note and bump package.json version to 0.9.2.
Sam H: done: bumped to 0.9.2 and added changelog. CI green just now.
merge-bot: CI passed on PR #412 — all checks green. :white_check_mark:
Maria G: approving SDK #412 :shipit:
Ken L: i'll open helm PR now and include a note about configmap key rename + runtime compatibility. PR link: github.com/redwood/helm-charts/pull/77 (draft).
Tara P: plan: 1) merge SDK #412 at 1705, 2) merge console PR #998 at 1715 (needs release build), 3) merge helm#77 + runtime followups at 1725. I'll hold the canary gate and watch logs for 30m.
Sam H: tagging @Maria G @Ken L for green-light. if anyone needs to delay, call it out now.
Ken L: good for me. i'll avoid any breaking config until after console merge.
Maria G: good to go. i'll hit approve and merge after 1705, watching e2e. :+1:
Sam H: thanks all — i'll post post-merge status here.
Tara P: if we see errors, fallback plan: revert console client bump, SDK stays but helm points to previous image tag. keep this thread for rollback notes.
Sam H: noted. starting the merge sequence in 5.
Sam H: merged SDK #412 at 1706.
merge-bot: PR #412 merged by Sam H — CI deployed to staging. :rocket:
Maria G: console build started, monitoring.
Sam H: console #998 merged at 1718, canary traffic 5%.
Tara P: canary looks clean so far (0 errors in primary path). incrementing to 25%.
Ken L: helm#77 updated to match image tag 0.9.2 and configmap key; opening runtime followup PR now.
Sam H: all done — thanks team. saved steps to run rollback in the ops runbook under /docs/runbooks/merge-orbit.md
Tara P: nice! closing loop. :tada:
